summary: Russia launched a massive missile and drone barrage across Ukraine, including two Zircon hypersonic missiles striking the Kremenchuk oil refinery and multiple rocket attacks on Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, and Poltava regions. Ukrainian forces conducted sabotage operations on Russian railways in Orenburg region, attacked the Novorossiysk oil terminal, and executed a cyberattack on Wildberries infrastructure. Russian sources claim 180 Ukrainian drones intercepted and the capture of Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region.
key_points: Two Zircon hypersonic missiles hit the Kremenchuk oil refinery in central Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70233)
Three rockets struck Bashtanka in Mykolaiv region; one rocket targeted Dykanka in Poltava region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70238)
Ballistic missile struck Nivky and Sviatoshyn districts of Kyiv during air raid alert. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70227)
Five UAVs detected over Black Sea heading toward Mykolaiv and Odesa regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/105481)
Ukrainian partisans destroyed railway cisterns with gas and gasoline in Orsk and Gai, Orenburg region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83452)
Drone attack forced shutdown of Novorossiysk Sheskharis oil terminal, main Russian Black Sea export hub. (Source: @UkraineNow/83442)
GUR Cyber Corps disrupted Wildberries digital infrastructure across Russia causing payment failures. (Source: @UkraineNow/83447)
Russian MoD claims 180 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted and liberation of Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/390466)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive missile and drone barrage across Ukraine, including two Zircon hypersonic missiles striking the Kremenchuk oil refinery and multiple rocket attacks on Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Kyiv, and Poltava regions. Ukrainian forces conducted sabotage operations on Russian railways in Orenburg region, attacked the Novorossiysk oil terminal, and executed a cyberattack on Wildberries infrastructure. Russian sources claim 180 Ukrainian drones intercepted and the capture of Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region.

points: Ukrainian partisans conducted dual railway sabotage in Orenburg region, destroying gas and gasoline cisterns in Orsk and Gai on the night of August 15, disrupting Russian rear logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/83452)

Ukrainian drones attacked the Novorossiysk Sheskharis oil terminal, the primary Russian Black Sea crude export facility handling 700,000 barrels daily, forcing a tanker to depart unloaded. (Source: @UkraineNow/83442)

GUR Cyber Corps launched a cyberattack on Wildberries, Russia's largest e-commerce platform, disrupting customer service channels, payment infrastructure, and contact centers nationwide. (Source: @UkraineNow/83447)
Ukrainian drone strikes on occupied Crimea caused a massive fire near Balaklava and cut power to western Crimean settlements after hitting energy infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/83439)

Commander-in-Chief Drapatiy appointed former 80th Airborne Assault Brigade commander Emil Ishkulov to lead Kramatorsk defense after his dismissal for opposing the 2024 Kursk operation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32482)

Russian forces launched two Zircon hypersonic missiles at the Kremenchuk oil refinery in Poltava region, marking a rare confirmed use of hypersonic weapons against energy infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70233)

Massive missile barrage included three rockets on Bashtanka (Mykolaiv), one on Dykanka (Poltava), ballistic missile on Kyiv's Nivky/Sviatoshyn, and strikes on Kropyvnytskyi, Bohodukhiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70238, @mon1tor_ua/70227, @mon1tor_ua/70207, @kpszsu/72965, @kpszsu/72912)
Russian tactical aviation conducted guided aerial bomb strikes on Sumy, Zaporizhzhia, and eastern Kharkiv regions using Su-34/Su-35 platforms. (Source: @kpszsu/72955, @kpszsu/72912, @kpszsu/72915)
Russian air defenses reportedly intercepted and destroyed 180 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions in a single day per MoD claim. (Source: @tass_agency/390466)
Russian MoD announced liberation of Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region, advancing in the southern Donbas sector. (Source: @tass_agency/390462)
Russian forces captured Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region per MoD claim, indicating incremental advances in the southern Donbas sector. (Source: @tass_agency/390462)
Guided aerial bomb strikes by Russian tactical aviation targeted eastern Kharkiv region and Zaporizhzhia region frontline positions. (Source: @kpszsu/72915, @kpszsu/72912)
New commander Emil Ishkulov appointed to organize Kramatorsk defense, replacing leadership after 80th Brigade's refusal to participate in Kursk operation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32482)
Missile strikes hit Kropyvnytskyi (Kh-59) and Dnipropetrovsk region, targeting rear logistics and command centers. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70207, @mon1tor_ua/70202)
Jet-powered UAVs detected in northern Dnipropetrovsk region moving westward, suggesting reconnaissance or strike missions against eastern Ukrainian groupings. (Source: @kpszsu/72971)
Ballistic missile struck Kyiv's Nivky and Sviatoshyn districts during 02:47 air raid alert, demonstrating continued threat to capital. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70227, @eRadarrua/105504)
Russian guided aerial bombs launched against Sumy region from tactical aviation, targeting border area infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/72955)

Strike UAVs launched from northern Sumy region flew westward toward Chernihiv region, with one guided UAV circling Chernihiv city before moving toward Berezny. (Source: @kpszsu/72937, @eRadarrua/105515)
Ballistic missile threat alerts active from northern and eastern directions per Ukrainian monitoring channels. (Source: @kpszsu/72957, @kpszsu/72956)
Kh-59 cruise missile tracked heading toward Kropyvnytskyi from northern trajectories. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70207)

Three rockets struck Bashtanka in Mykolaiv region; additional rocket north of Voskresenske heading toward Nova Odesa; rocket in Beryslav district (Kherson) heading toward Mykolaiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70238, @kpszsu/72938, @kpszsu/72932)
Five UAVs over Black Sea split toward Mykolaiv and Odesa regions; jet-powered UAV from Black Sea heading to Odesa region. (Source: @eRadarrua/105481, @kpszsu/72916)

Strike UAVs active in Mykolaiv region near Berezanka moving northward; three UAVs near Vilniansk and one jet-powered UAV near Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/72946, @eRadarrua/105445)
Ukrainian drone attack on Novorossiysk Sheskharis terminal halted operations at Russia's primary Black Sea oil export hub (700k bpd). (Source: @UkraineNow/83442)
Drone strikes on occupied Crimea caused major fire near Balaklava and power outages across western Crimea after energy infrastructure hits. (Source: @UkraineNow/83439)

Two Zircon hypersonic missiles fired at Kremenchuk oil refinery; Kh-59 cruise missile toward Kropyvnytskyi; ballistic missile on Kyiv suburbs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70233, @mon1tor_ua/70207, @mon1tor_ua/70227)
Multiple rocket strikes across Mykolaiv, Poltava, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kirovohrad regions within short timeframe. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70238, @kpszsu/72965, @kpszsu/72934, @mon1tor_ua/70202)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Sumy, Zaporizhzhia, and eastern Kharkiv regions. (Source: @kpszsu/72955, @kpszsu/72912, @kpszsu/72915)

Ukrainian UAV campaign: 5+ drones over Black Sea, jet-powered UAVs in Dnipropetrovsk and from Black Sea, strike UAVs in Sumy, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/105481, @kpszsu/72971, @kpszsu/72916, @kpszsu/72937, @kpszsu/72946, @eRadarrua/105515)
Russian air defense claimed 180 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted over Russian territory in 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/390466)

key_developments: Two Zircon hypersonic missiles struck Kremenchuk oil refinery in Poltava region, marking confirmed hypersonic weapon use against Ukrainian energy infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70233)

Massive coordinated missile barrage hit Bashtanka (3), Dykanka (1), Kyiv Nivky/Sviatoshyn (ballistic), Kropyvnytskyi (Kh-59), Bohodukhiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions within hours. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70238, @mon1tor_ua/70227, @mon1tor_ua/70207, @kpszsu/72965, @kpszsu/72912)
Ukrainian partisans destroyed railway fuel cisterns in Orsk and Gai, Orenburg region, disrupting Russian southern military logistics on night of August 15. (Source: @UkraineNow/83452)
Drone attack forced shutdown of Novorossiysk Sheskharis terminal, Russia's main Black Sea oil export hub handling 700,000 bpd, causing tanker diversion. (Source: @UkraineNow/83442)
GUR Cyber Corps disabled Wildberries e-commerce platform across Russia, disrupting payments, customer service, and contact centers nationwide. (Source: @UkraineNow/83447)
Russian MoD claims 180 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted over Russian regions and capture of Rybal'ske in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/390466, @tass_agency/390462)
Ukrainian drone strikes on occupied Crimea caused major Balaklava fire and blackouts across western Crimea after energy infrastructure damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/83439)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is intensifying long-range strikes using hypersonic Zircon missiles and massed rocket barrages targeting energy and urban centers across Ukraine, indicating a deliberate campaign to degrade infrastructure before winter. Ukrainian asymmetric response has expanded to strategic Russian territory: railway sabotage in the Urals, drone strikes on critical oil export infrastructure, and cyberattacks on major commercial platforms. The simultaneous ballistic missile threat from northern and eastern axes suggests Russia maintains robust launch capabilities despite Ukrainian air defense improvements. Russian claims of 180 UAV interceptions indicate massive Ukrainian drone operations penetrating deep into Russian airspace.
sections.regional_response: EU financial support mechanism shifts to "money for real progress toward EU" model linking 8.3 billion euros to judicial, anti-corruption, and prosecutorial reforms, reducing risk of funding loss over individual unmet indicators. Belgium now requires Ukrainian asylum seekers to present Reserve+ military registration data, extending mobilization tracking abroad. Domestic Ukrainian criticism highlights that winter relocation costs (250,000 UAH) are unaffordable for average earners (15,000-20,000 UAH), potentially forcing vulnerable populations to remain in targeted cities. Monument removal in Dnipro (Soviet commander Margelov replaced by Ukrainian paratroopers memorial) reflects ongoing decommunization.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Zircon strike on Kremenchuk refinery confirms operational deployment of hypersonic missiles against stationary high-value targets, likely signaling willingness to expend limited stockpiles for strategic effect. Partisan railway attacks in Orenburg (2,000+ km from front) demonstrate Ukrainian reach into Russian strategic depth, targeting fuel logistics for southern grouping. Novorossiysk terminal attack threatens 700k bpd export capacity, exacerbating Russian domestic fuel shortages reported across 16 regions. Cyberattack on Wildberries shows GUR capacity to disrupt Russian digital economy at scale. Russian MoD's Rybal'ske capture claim, if verified, would mark tactical gain in Zaporizhzhia sector amid broader Ukrainian pressure.
